description.value: Jake's Pub & Grill is a long-running neighbourhood pub and grill located on the Cariboo Highway in 100 Mile House, a key waypoint on BC's interior cycling corridor. Claiming 27 years of operation, it offers a broad menu spanning breakfast, burgers, mains, sandwiches, salads, and a full bar with cocktails and shots. Locals and travellers alike are welcome, making it a practical sit-down resupply stop for cyclists passing through the Cariboo region.

address.value: 365 Cariboo Hwy 100 Mile House BC V0K2E0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at jakespub.ca is fully accessible and provides strong primary evidence: address (365 Cariboo Hwy, 100 Mile House BC V0K2E0), two phone numbers, and a full food and drinks menu with an online ordering/cart system. The OSM record contains no contact details beyond the URL, so address and phone are sourced from the website. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the Veggie Spring Rolls menu listing provides the sole evidence for a vegetarian option, and the online 'Order Now' / shop-cart system confirms takeout availability.
concerns: OSM record contains no address, phone, or email; all contact details sourced solely from the website.
Two phone numbers listed on site: 250-395-1274 (main contact) and 250-270-1110 (listed as 'Hot Line'). Primary number used.

Website 'Best Chef Collection' section contains lorem ipsum placeholder text alongside dishes ('Assorted Sushi', 'Smoked Wagyu', 'Crispbread Caviar') inconsistent with the rest of the menu, suggesting the site template was not fully customised — content reliability is otherwise good.
No cycling-specific amenities confirmed; a site visit or direct contact would be needed to verify bike parking and washroom access.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating pub and grill on the Cariboo Highway in 100 Mile House — a significant stop on a major BC interior cycling route — offering full meals, drinks, and online ordering. Clear value for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Veggie Spring Rolls as a standalone appetizer item, confirming at least one vegetarian option. No vegan or GF labelling found
